info.title: ScreenshotAPI Universal API
info.description: Capture, extract, and automate website screenshots and web content

post.description: Creates extracted page HTML in ScreenshotAPI.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

fresh.description: When true, request a newly rendered capture instead of cached output.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when ScreenshotAPI created the capture.

extractedHtml.description: URL of the extracted HTML file.

fresh.description: Whether ScreenshotAPI forced a fresh render.

screenshot.description: URL of the generated screenshot file.

sizes.description: Optional sizes payload returned by ScreenshotAPI.

ttl.description: Expiration timestamp for the generated file.

url.description: Captured page URL returned by ScreenshotAPI.
